transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 1). A novel respiratory virus has been confirmed in three US cities, with likely undetected spread. Early case reports are alarming but the sample is tiny and biased toward the sickest. You do not yet know the true infection-fatality rate or how transmissible it is. Hospitals in the affected cities report rising admissions. Markets fell 4% on the news. The WHO has called an emergency meeting.

Your health agencies want aggressive early action 'to be safe'; your economic team warns that shutting down on a maybe could be its own catastrophe; governors are looking to you for a lead but guard their authority. Every option has a cost, and you must choose before the data is in. What do you do?

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: We cannot manage what we cannot measure; aggressive testing and genomic surveillance will reveal the true scope of spread and inform every subsequent decision.

actions.rationale: We cannot manage what we cannot measure; aggressive testing and genomic surveillance will reveal the true scope of spread and inform every subsequent decision.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Public trust is the foundation of crisis response; honest, data-driven daily briefings prevent panic and rumor from filling the information vacuum.

actions.rationale: Public trust is the foundation of crisis response; honest, data-driven daily briefings prevent panic and rumor from filling the information vacuum.

actions.name: public_dashboard

params.rationale: A transparent national data dashboard gives governors, hospitals, and the public a shared factual picture and coordinates the national response.

actions.rationale: A transparent national data dashboard gives governors, hospitals, and the public a shared factual picture and coordinates the national response.

actions.name: invoke_dpa

params.rationale: Supply chains for PPE, tests, and ventilators will lag by weeks; invoking the DPA now ensures we have critical supplies before a surge, not after.

actions.rationale: Supply chains for PPE, tests, and ventilators will lag by weeks; invoking the DPA now ensures we have critical supplies before a surge, not after.

actions.name: travel_restrictions

params.rationale: Restricting inbound travel from affected regions slows the introduction of new cases and buys time for domestic surveillance and preparedness.

actions.rationale: Restricting inbound travel from affected regions slows the introduction of new cases and buys time for domestic surveillance and preparedness.

actions.name: fund_vaccine

params.rationale: Vaccine and therapeutics development takes 12-18 months; starting a crash program now is the only way to have tools ready when the crisis peaks.

actions.rationale: Vaccine and therapeutics development takes 12-18 months; starting a crash program now is the only way to have tools ready when the crisis peaks.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: We will need emergency funding and statutory authority for testing, supplies, and economic support; engaging Congress now ensures readiness to act quickly.

actions.rationale: We will need emergency funding and statutory authority for testing, supplies, and economic support; engaging Congress now ensures readiness to act quickly.

transcript.narrative: Testing and sequencing capacity expands; the picture sharpens.

transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 2). Estimated infection index 1.3 (was 1.0 at week 1). Deaths to date: 0.
Economy index 99/100. Public trust 58/100. Hospital strain 2/100. Restriction level 0.5/10.
Vaccine/therapeutics progress: 26/100.
ASSESSMENT (LOW confidence): data remain too thin to pin down severity; estimates span from 'bad flu' to 'catastrophic.'

actions.name: mask_mandate

params.rationale: Masking is a low-cost, low-economic-damage intervention that slows transmission now while we await clarity on severity; it also signals federal seriousness to governors and the public.

actions.rationale: Masking is a low-cost, low-economic-damage intervention that slows transmission now while we await clarity on severity; it also signals federal seriousness to governors and the public.

actions.name: protect_vulnerable

params.rationale: With severity still uncertain but spread confirmed, focusing early protection on the elderly and high-risk is a prudent insurance policy that keeps society open while shielding those most likely to die.

actions.rationale: With severity still uncertain but spread confirmed, focusing early protection on the elderly and high-risk is a prudent insurance policy that keeps society open while shielding those most likely to die.

actions.name: economic_relief

params.rationale: With infection spreading to a dozen new states, we may need stricter measures soon; pre-positioning economic relief ensures households and small businesses can comply with restrictions without facing financial ruin.
